item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `SchemaAwareDummy(DummyLM)` with `dspy.JSONAdapter()`, and sets both `supported_params` to include `response_format` and `supports_response_schema = True`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `Loose.data` as `dict[str, Any]`, the open-ended mapping annotation required to trigger the incompatible structured-output case."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Records `loose_format` from LM history and asserts it equals exactly `{\"type\": \"json_object\"}`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `Tight.answer` as a normal typed output (`str`), which exercises the structured-output branch for the typed case."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Validates the typed `response_format` as a generated schema class via `isinstance(tight_format, type)` and `issubclass(..., pydantic.BaseModel)`."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
